issue.title: Qualify learned soft-role and compound binding through unchanged R4

milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
Qualify the retained #1077 learned full soft-role interface and frozen #1073 compound-binding core through the unchanged native R4 frame path. Parent #973; prerequisites #1077 and #1075 are complete.

Reference: the retained learned ordinary soft execution, including its full token-role mixtures and four-fact-plus-null attention. The older hard-field oracle is historical semantic evidence, not the preservation comparator.

Implement one inference-only adapter: transport each valid token embedding from its cumulative native prefix frame to its clause-end frame, pool all three learned soft roles, and decode before the frozen ordinary norms/projections. Then reuse the qualified compound R4 attention with four fact clause-end frames, full-question-end query frame and identity null. Keep contextual role scoring and softmax unchanged. Fold actual valid tokens continuously across clauses; padding is excluded. Aliases 52–56 retain their existing native token-ID map.

One frozen campaign and one fresh-process exact replay, across both construction and four development views already observed in #1077. Ordinary must exactly reproduce the retained learned-path evidence. Coherent R4 must preserve every prediction and supervised role decision, exact reader attention, maximum full-head difference <=0.005, binding attention and computed role-vector differences <=1e-5, and each-view mean NLL difference <=1e-5. No fitting, new semantic data, geometry export/expansion, generation or runtime search.

Only after all primary criteria pass, isolate both transport seams: cycle valid token transport-source frames inside each clause, and separately cycle four fact transport-source frames with null fixed. Retain true source encoding and equal work. Preflight actual changed native matrices and supported-row opportunity before scoring; >=50 percentage-point supported accuracy loss per view establishes strong sensitivity. Weaker sensitivity does not erase valid primary preservation.

Budget: CPU four intraop threads, one interop thread, one process, batch 256; 4 GiB and shared 900 seconds for run plus replay. Per arm: 25,600 answers, 1,561,600 valid tokens, 384,000 computed role vectors, 358,400 supervised roles, 128,000 binding pairs including 25,600 nulls. Four arms plus replay admit at most 204,800 learned forward rows. Source #1077 evaluation took 12.174 seconds; this anchors ordinary cost, not added f64 transport cost.

Definition of done: frozen source and exact preparation published before learned forwards; independent preflight; one run and exact independent-process replay; append-only evidence record and truthful current mirrors; focused mechanism/provenance checks; protected PR delivery; verify merged tree, update native parents/milestone, and close only this issue. #973 stays open; #954 remains blocked.

If preserved, retain the qualified two-stage path and separately freeze the next bounded causal output-state experiment toward token-by-token response generation. If preservation fails, retain #1077 ordinary execution and localize this transport mismatch without tuning or repeating this campaign. A weak/invalid control limits attribution and requires a separately declared diagnostic, not geometry expansion.

### #1079 completion (2026-09-02)

Completed via protected PR #1080 at `e627252e525201815169ffd8364184953a46018d`, with reviewed/merged tree `cd2211de34ca013f8c333df5cf48f75944e05227`. [Full DoD evidence and next action](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/issues/973#issuecomment-5519385959); [record](https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/r4_zoology_language_r4_1079.md). Frozen source/preparation, independent admission, sole campaign, exact replay, final evidence review, six current mirrors and native parent/milestone updates are complete. The measured terminal is LANGUAGE_R4_PRESERVED_CONTROL_WEAK; primary preservation and strong fact sensitivity are retained. Closing only this completed experiment. #973 stays open; #954 remains blocked.
